_comment: Organisations on the map and the exact names they appear under in USAspending.gov, checked by hand with its recipient search. Keys are map labels. A value is a list of names, or an object with names plus a description regex for recipients whose awards mostly belong to someone else (MIT Lincoln Laboratory's contracts are made out to MIT). University-based centres (Johns Hopkins CHS, Georgetown CGHSS, CIDRAP and others) are left out: their awards go to the university and can't be told apart. NTI, CEPI and the Institute for Progress have no federal awards listed.

Global Health Policy Center at the Cente: CENTER FOR STRATEGIC AND INTERNATIONAL STUDIES, INC
Sandia National Laboratories (SNL): NATIONAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS OF SANDIA, LLC
